'''Adamas Space Station''' was an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] operating under the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Darth Nox]] was known to pass through this space station during their search for ancient ghosts.
